messages.subject: Project Ironhold - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm delighted to confirm that Project Ironhold has completed today. All conditions precedent were satisfied, the funds flow has settled, and the first super-senior drawdown of 3.6m has been made. The executed Amendment and Restatement Agreement is attached for the file.

Headline as executed: senior facilities extended to 31 December 2029; Facility A margin 4.50% over SONIA; 12m super-senior new money; amendment fee 690,000; reset covenants with a testing holiday to Q4 2026 and a 0.60x super-senior cap; 6m of shareholder loans converted to equity and the residual 15m subordinated.

Thank you all for a well-run process.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
